scope: Read-only saved status extension recovery visibility on native stopped sites and incompatible VHost source; manual Apply/Restore still require verified running target

native_qa.platform: Debian 12 / aaPanel 8.0.7 / Nginx / PHP 8.1 and 8.5 / 3 WordPress
positive_checks: Verified existing native WordPress site ID6 has eligible Nginx extension include
Plugin-owned 404 and 502 both applied, actual HTTP status/body hash and operation nonce PASS
Native SiteStop changed root to shared stop directory and commented native includes
Stopped site returned /index.html HTTP 200 with exact native stop-file hash after worker readiness
For each managed status, stopped Recheck exposed saved operation ID, phase applied and saved SHA while reporting no live verification
Both native primary-admin Apply and Restore denied while stopped; journals and configuration unchanged by Recheck
Native SiteStart restored the exact initial VHost bytes; after Nginx worker readiness both 404 and 502 returned Applied with exact status/body/proof
Deliberate benign VHost source edit resulted in Needs Review with saved operation and explicit denial of Restore; journals unchanged
After restoring exact VHost bytes, 404 exact Restore and 502 Source Restored passed
WP1, WP2 and WP3 HTTP 200 and exact VHost hashes, original WP1 status source files and global stop HTML hashes unchanged; Nginx syntax PASS
native_qa.negative_discovery: Brand-new native PHP site ID9 lacked an extension/<site>/*.conf include/directory. Guarded source preflight rejected Apply before mutation; feature does not patch vendor-generated VHost.
native_qa.readiness: Real aaPanel SiteStop/SiteStart return before all Nginx worker generations settle. Candidate test driver uses bounded independent HTTP status, body and nonce readiness, not extra reloads. Initial transient old HTTP200/Drift observations did not indicate permanent failure.
native_qa.test_authority: Existing isolated disposable QEMU overlay, synthetic Flask primary-admin POST; NOT real browser/CSRF.

remaining.site_stopped_status: Native aaPanel stopped homepage still HTTP200, NOT 503. This package does not change it.
remaining.new_sites: Newly created sites without native extension include remain guarded-Apply ineligible.
remaining.other_status: Unknown HTTPS/443 Host and generic 50x active routing remain unsupported.
remaining.qa: Real authenticated aaPanel browser/CSRF/secondary accounts and complete lifecycle acceptance remain open in Issue #21.
